surface.description: Authenticated X reading, research, drafting, and approval-gated reply publication.

prompt.mission: Research visible conversations, preserve the user's draft, and help prepare relationship-first replies through reusable X actions.
prompt.boundaries: Read freely. Draft only after reading x.reply.composer and preserving its exact current text. Never publish, follow, unfollow, like, repost, bookmark, or send a direct message without the user's explicit approval for that exact mutation. After publication, independently read x.thread.visible and confirm the expected text and permalink.

notes.measured_surface: Validated in a regular authenticated Chrome tab on extension 0.1.224. The reply editor is [data-testid='tweetTextarea_0'][contenteditable='true'] with role=textbox and accessible name 'Post text'. The inline submit button is [data-testid='tweetButtonInline'] and reads 'Reply'.
notes.timeline_extraction: X virtualizes timelines. A visible-state read is a bounded viewport observation, not a complete thread or feed. Accumulate by permalink while scrolling when deeper coverage is required.
notes.text_extraction_gotcha: browser.extract_elements uses the pseudo-attribute 'text'. 'textContent' is not the pseudo-attribute and returned empty strings during live authoring on 2026-07-15.
notes.approval_boundary: x.reply.draft.replace_if_unchanged never submits. x.reply.publish_approved is the only publication action and requires the exact composer text plus approval='APPROVE PUBLISH'. A caller must receive explicit user approval for that exact text immediately before invoking it.

tools.name: x.outreach.map
tools.description: Return the operating contract for authenticated X outreach. Call this before researching, drafting, or publishing.

static_output.purpose: Relationship-first X research and outreach through stored actions.
static_output.read: Use x.timeline.visible on feeds/profiles/search, x.notifications.visible on Notifications, and x.thread.visible on a status page.
static_output.draft: Read x.reply.composer first. Pass its exact text as expected_existing_text to x.reply.draft.replace_if_unchanged. A mismatch skips the replacement.
static_output.publish: Only after explicit approval for the exact draft: call x.reply.publish_approved with exact_text and approval='APPROVE PUBLISH', then independently read x.thread.visible and verify the text and permalink.

tools.name: x.notifications.open
tools.description: Open the authenticated Notifications surface through X's visible navigation. Verify by reading x.notifications.visible after navigation settles.

x_state_machine.readiness: the signed-in primary Notifications link is resolved by its measured test identity immediately before pointer.click

workflow.output: {% {'opened': true, 'expected_url': 'https://x.com/notifications', 'next_step': 'Read x.notifications.visible and verify source_url begins https://x.com/notifications.'} %}

tools.name: x.search.url
tools.description: Build an authenticated X Latest-search URL. Open the returned URL in the claimed regular Chrome tab, then read x.timeline.visible.

query.description: X search query, including operators such as from:, to:, since:, until:, or filter:replies.

workflow.output: {% {'query': input.query, 'url': 'https://x.com/search?q=' & $encodeUrlComponent(input.query) & '&f=live', 'next_step': 'Open this URL in the claimed regular Chrome tab and read x.timeline.visible.'} %}

tools.name: x.profile.url
tools.description: Build an X profile URL from a handle. This does not navigate or mutate the account.

handle.description: X handle with or without the leading @.

workflow.output: {% ($h := $replace(input.handle, '@', ''); {'handle': $h, 'url': 'https://x.com/' & $h, 'next_step': 'Open this URL in the claimed regular Chrome tab and read x.timeline.visible.'}) %}

tools.name: x.post.url
tools.description: Build an exact X post URL from a handle and numeric post id. This does not navigate or mutate the account.

workflow.output: {% ($h := $replace(input.handle, '@', ''); {'handle': $h, 'post_id': input.post_id, 'url': 'https://x.com/' & $h & '/status/' & input.post_id, 'next_step': 'Open this URL in the claimed regular Chrome tab and read x.thread.visible.'}) %}

tools.name: x.reply.draft.replace_if_unchanged
tools.description: Replace or clear the visible reply draft only when its current text exactly matches expected_existing_text. Read x.reply.composer immediately before calling. This action never clicks Reply and never publishes.

expected_existing_text.description: Exact text returned by the immediately preceding x.reply.composer read. Use an empty string only when the read proved the composer was empty.

text.description: Complete replacement draft. Pass an empty string to clear a draft whose exact current text was just read. This is not published by this action.

x_state_machine.requires_state: a visible reply composer whose exact text was just read with x.reply.composer

workflow.output: {% {'applied': steps.readBefore.output.text = input.expected_existing_text and steps.readAfter.output.text = input.text, 'expected_existing_text': input.expected_existing_text, 'observed_before': steps.readBefore.output.text, 'observed_after': steps.readAfter.output.text, 'published': false, 'next_step': 'Read x.reply.composer independently. Do not publish without explicit user approval for the exact observed draft.'} %}

tools.name: x.reply.publish_approved
tools.description: Publish the visible reply only after the user explicitly approved this exact text. Requires approval='APPROVE PUBLISH' and an exact composer-text match. After this action, independently read x.thread.visible and confirm the expected text and permalink before reporting success.

exact_text.description: The exact reply text explicitly approved by the user and currently visible in x.reply.composer.

approval.description: Supply only after the user explicitly approves publishing exact_text.

expected_author_handle.description: Signed-in account handle, with or without @, used to bind the publication postcondition to the expected author.

x_state_machine.requires_state: the user explicitly approved input.exact_text for publication and x.reply.composer exactly matches it
x_state_machine.postcondition: x.thread.visible contains input.exact_text from input.expected_author_handle with a permalink

workflow.output: {% {'submitted': input.approval = 'APPROVE PUBLISH' and steps.findComposer.output.text = input.exact_text and steps.findReplyButton.output.text = 'Reply', 'exact_text': input.exact_text, 'expected_author_handle': $replace(input.expected_author_handle, '@', ''), 'verification_required': true, 'next_step': 'Read x.thread.visible independently. Confirm an article authored by expected_author_handle contains exact_text and capture its permalink. Do not report publication from this action alone.'} %}

state_projections.name: x.timeline.visible
state_projections.description: Visible X posts currently mounted in the virtualized timeline. This is a bounded viewport observation, not a complete feed.

state_projections.name: x.notifications.visible
state_projections.description: Visible notification articles on the authenticated Notifications surface.

x.notifications.open.failure_message: X did not land on the Notifications surface after navigation.

state_projections.name: x.thread.visible
state_projections.description: Visible posts mounted in the current X conversation, including author, text, timestamp, and permalink when present.

x.reply.publish_approved.failure_message: The expected reply text was not independently found under the expected author with a permalink.

state_projections.name: x.reply.composer
state_projections.description: Current visible X reply draft and submit-control state. Read immediately before every draft replacement and immediately before requesting publication approval.

projection.expression: {% ($draft := $type(records.composer.text) = 'string' ? records.composer.text : ''; $composerLabel := $type(records.composer.aria_label) = 'string' ? records.composer.aria_label : ''; $composerRole := $type(records.composer.role) = 'string' ? records.composer.role : ''; $submitLabel := $type(records.submit.label) = 'string' ? records.submit.label : ''; {'source_url': url, 'draft_text': $draft, 'draft_length': $length($draft), 'composer_label': $composerLabel, 'composer_role': $composerRole, 'submit_label': $submitLabel, 'submit_disabled': $type(records.submit.disabled) = 'string', 'complete': $composerLabel = 'Post text' and $composerRole = 'textbox' and $submitLabel = 'Reply'}) %}

summaries.name: approval_context
summaries.expression: {% {'source_url': state.source_url, 'draft_text': state.draft_text, 'draft_length': state.draft_length, 'submit_disabled': state.submit_disabled, 'complete': state.complete, 'warning': 'Publication requires explicit user approval for this exact draft_text.'} %}

x.reply.draft.replace_if_unchanged.failure_message: The reply composer did not contain the exact requested draft after replacement.
